paragraphs.text: Cho-Akhan was a Cho-Arrim herbalist living in a village in the Rushwood , on the plane of Mercadia .

While out looking for herbs, 'Akhan happened upon the ancient tomb of the shaman Sia-am-Erh , who was wearing the Ancestral Mask , covered in golden glowing moths. After 'Akhan's village was struck by plague from Mercadia City , and her brother Cho-Ran died from the sickness, she decided to wield the Ancestral Mask to protect her village and conquer the plaguebearers from the city.

The Ancestral Mask took control of 'Akhan's body and plummeted her into the River , where she bonded with the souls of the deceased Cho-Arrim, including her brother. Each soul picked off a shard of the mask, leaving behind a jagged set of scars on 'Akhan's face, and imbuing her with their power.
Thus armed, 'Akhan and her two mothers, Cho-Shadi and Cho-Fihad , prepared for war with Mercadia City.
